lead_raw_text:
The structure of K4Mn2Bi2O12 (reduced formula K2MnBiO6) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi and Mn each adopt octahedral coordination by six O atoms, while K exhibits a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 O neighbors. The oxygen centers have two geometric neighbors, one Bi and one Mn. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between BiO6 and MnO6 octahedra, and face-sharing between K-centered 12-vertex polyhedra and both BiO6 and MnO6 octahedra.
